🚀 poznote | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A self-hosted platform for individuals and teams to manage notes, documentation, and tasks in a centralized and organized manner.
✨ Key Features: • Note-taking and documentation platform • Self-hosted web application • Supports notes, tasks, and wiki content • Git synchronization • AI Assistant
📖 Summary: Poznote is a self-hosted, open-source note-taking and documentation platform built with JavaScript. It offers a web application for organizing notes, tasks, and wikis, with features like Git synchronization, AI assistance, and multi-user support.
